_comment: Mod ids that declare `environment: "*"` in fabric.mod.json but are really
client-only, and will crash or misbehave on a dedicated server.
This list is EXPECTED TO BE INCOMPLETE. Fabric's environment field is
advisory and widely mis-declared, so no static list can cover an arbitrary
modpack. Mods that declare `client` properly are excluded automatically and
do not belong here. When crash triage identifies a new one it is appended to
client_only.user.json in the app's state directory, and good candidates get
Seeded from a real 143-mod Fabric 26.2 pack.
